content.short: Linkage Finance is a decentralized index fund protocol on Cardano for simplified and diversified investing.
content.description: Linkage Finance is an innovative decentralized fund protocol on Cardano that enables users to invest in a diversified basket of native tokens through a single index token. By utilizing non-custodial smart contracts, the protocol allows for the creation and management of funds that track the performance of various market indexes. This approach simplifies the investment process, reducing the time and fees associated with individual asset management. Linkage Finance provides the transparency, security, and accessibility needed for both retail and institutional investors to navigate the ecosystem.
